checks.assertion: - Synthetic gateway and cross-runtime fixtures cover supported round trips, default weekdays, monthly gaps, timezone/dayStart differences, external edits, stale previews, unsupported fields, lost acknowledgement and absence of score/Cron effects.
criteria: Supported exact linked schedule edits preserve representable rules and retain original receipts plus effective-dated schedule facts.
Unsupported or uncertain schedules remain clearly unavailable without field loss, penalty promises, backfilled scores or implicit account changes.
